name: Spambot
description: Anti-spam module that uses data from www.stopforumspam.com to protect the user registration form against known spammers and spambots.
project_description:
Spambot protects the user registration form from spammers and spambots by verifying registration attempts against the Stop Forum Spam online database - no registration or API Key required for blocking, (free) API Key required for reporting spam emails/IPs. It also adds some useful features to help deal with spam accounts. 

 Additionally, with 8.x-1.3+ can integrate with the webform module - configure per form.

 This module works well for sites which require user registration before posting is allowed (which is most forums).

 Back to top 

 Features 
 
 
Checks (username, email, ip address) data against the www.stopforumspam.com database. Blocking can be based on either of email, username or IP address (with configurable thresholds).
 
 
Scanning of existing user accounts (via cron).
 
 
New 'spam' tab for user accounts with some useful information and actions.
 
 
Optionally report accounts as spammers. (Requires Stop Forum Spam API Key)
 
 
White lists for IP/email/usernames
 
 Integrate with webforms through UI configuration. 
 
Easy integrated to any custom forms (checking only by IP)
 
 
Uses IP addresses from core statistics and User Stats if they are enabled.
 
 
 If you need more IP address statistics of your users, please consider the User Stats module. 

 Back to top 

 Sample Data 
 To test this module, you can visit www.stopforumspam.com and use any of the data from their 'Recent Submissions' section as samples.
